basics.name: Priya Sharma
basics.summary: Backend engineer with 7 years building data-intensive payments and analytics platforms in Python and Go, specializing in high-throughput pipelines on Kubernetes.

highlights.text: Owned the ledger migration to double-entry accounting.

work.summary: Core payments platform team serving 4 million monthly active users.
highlights: Cut payment settlement latency 40% by redesigning the Kafka consumer pipeline in Python
Scaled transaction ingestion from 1.2k to 9k events per second across 30 microservices
Led migration of 45 services to Kubernetes, reducing deploy time from 25 minutes to 6
Introduced OpenTelemetry tracing across 60 endpoints, cutting mean time to diagnosis 35%
Drove PostgreSQL partitioning project that reduced p99 query time from 800ms to 120ms
Mentored 4 engineers; 2 promoted within a year
Built ETL pipelines in Python processing 3M records daily into PostgreSQL and Redis
Reduced infra spend 22% ($180k annually) by consolidating 12 EC2 instances onto 5
Shipped a GraphQL API used by 15 internal teams with p95 latency under 90ms
Automated CI/CD with GitHub Actions, cutting the release cycle from 2 weeks to 2 days
Wrote 500+ unit and integration tests, raising coverage from 48% to 85%
Developed 9 REST endpoints in Go for the customer onboarding flow
Built a Docker-based local development environment adopted by all 18 engineers
Migrated legacy cron jobs to Airflow, eliminating 30 manual hours per month
Introduced load tests that caught a connection-pool leak ahead of 5x festive traffic
Fixed 120+ bugs across the billing module with zero regressions

projects.name: OpenLedger
projects.description: Open-source double-entry ledger library in Python
highlights: Designed an immutable ledger engine processing 50k journal entries per second
Grew the project to 1.8k GitHub stars and 12 contributors

projects.name: QueueScope
highlights: Built consumer-lag alerts that cut incident response time 30%
Deployed on Kubernetes across 3 clusters monitoring 200 topics
